items.title: Public CLI package
items.scope: The headless CLI runs files, project roots, and Run Capsules today, and every stable release publishes signed standalone Windows and Linux archives alongside the public checksum manifest. The remaining step is the first guarded registry publication, so the CLI can be installed by name instead of built from source.

items.title: Signed Windows installer and winget
items.scope: Windows builds, installs, and auto-updates from GitHub Releases today, and the winget manifests are generated and validated from published checksums. The remaining step is public Authenticode trust, which removes the SmartScreen warning and unblocks the winget submission.
